The Bat is an [[enemy]] found exclusively in {{chapter|The Caves}}.

== Behavior ==
The Bat is a weak but agile enemy with permanent {{st|Flying|Flight}}, a {{st|Dodge Chance|#=50%}}, and is notably one of very few enemies to have a non-standard {{stat|Luck}} stat, boasting 8 Luck instead of the usual 5, further improving its ability to dodge attacks.

On its turn, the Bat will move towards a target and use a multi-hitting melee attack, dealing 1 damage 4 times. Each hit has a 57.5% (base 50%, improved by luck) chance to inflict {{st|Confusion}}. 

If a Bat is targeted by an attack, regardless of if it got hit or dodged it, it will immediately retreat from the attacker.

=== Tips ===
* Inflicting {{st|Marked}} or using an ability that can’t miss bypasses its ability to dodge.
* {{element|Gravity}} element abilities will {{st|Immobile|Immobilize}} the Bat if they connect, disabling its ability to run away. 
* [[Edmund]] himself recommends using {{st|Thorns}} and/or having a good {{stat|Luck}} stat.<ref>https://x.com/edmundmcmillen/status/2034018139542065183</ref>

== Trivia ==
* According to Edmund, Bats were intentionally made to to be annoying<ref>[https://youtu.be/bxFG2xZvSOM "It's kind of a rule ... in a video game, when you make a bat, it needs to be really fucking annoying"] </ref>.
** They may be inspired by [[bulba:Zubat|Zubat]] as both are bats without legs or eyes, and inflict confusion.
* The level editor sprite resembles {{Wikipedia|Batman|Batman’s}} symbol.
